name: Bamboo-shoot salad
summary: Boiled bamboo shoot with belly pork and shrimp. Người Lao Động names măng tre tàu, rau răm, fried shallot, and peanuts. Báo Quốc tế says some kitchens toss it in sweet-sour fish sauce and some leave the sauce on the side.
origin: Củ Chi. Người Lao Động ties the shoot to tầm vông, tre, and trúc in the district. Báo Quốc tế calls it a household plate.
howToEat: Người Lao Động: shave măng tre tàu, soak it in salt water, and boil it repeatedly so it is not bitter. Mix with boiled belly pork and boiled shrimp, rau răm, fried shallot, and roasted peanuts. Eat it plain or with fried shrimp crackers. The sauce is sweet-sour fish sauce.

Báo Quốc tế: fresh bamboo, boiled so it is not bitter and does not darken, with belly pork, peeled shrimp, garlic, and chili, tossed with sweet-sour fish sauce. Some places leave the sauce for you to add.
